name: session-cockpit
description: Side pane and prompt band: context, cost and cache clock, budget guard, PR/CI status, live subagent tree, destructive-command guard, diff replay, activity log

budgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: Tool calls are refused once the session costs this much. 0 turns the guard off. /budget changes it for one session.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a reply: 5m or 1h, as your plan or settings use.

transcriptStyle.title: Transcript style
transcriptStyle.description: cockpit redraws the spinner, your prompts and tool rows; claude leaves the transcript as Claude Code draws it.

notifyHeadsUp.title: Notify on You should know
notifyHeadsUp.description: Raise a system notification (a toast in the desktop app) when Claude Code's You should know mod shows a new note above the prompt.
